A '''slugthrower rifle''' (or simply '''"rifle"''') was a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] and a larger two-handed version of the [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]]. It was a vast improvement from a [[musket]].

==Description==
Like their [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|pistol]] counterpart, the slugthrower rifle used a chemical reaction to fire a [[Slug/Legends|slug]], or solid projectile, at high velocity towards a target. They had much longer [[Barrel/Legends|barrels]] than pistols, allowing them to fire at longer distances using larger slugs.<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" />

Slugthrower rifles were generally loaded with magazines that held 20 slugs, each mag costing 40 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighing 0.2 kg. Some rifles had an autofire mode, allowing for rapid automatic fire.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Typical models of a slugthrower rifle include the [[Dressellian Projectile Rifle]] and [[6-2Aug2 hunting rifle/Legends|6-2Aug2 hunting rifle]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" />

Rifles were used by the military of newly industrialized civilizations.<ref name="TRG1" /> They were also carried by petty criminals and street thugs that infested cities across the galaxy during the [[Rebellion era]]. Crude versions of these weapons were also used by primitive cultures, such as the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" />
